theorem lg_target : (Finset.filter (fun n => n % 3 = 0) (Finset.range 30)).card = 10 := by
  have h : (Finset.filter (fun n => n % 3 = 0) (Finset.range 30)).card = Nat.count (fun n => n % 3 = 0) 30 :=
    by simp only [Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range]
  have h' : Nat.count (fun n => n % 3 = 0) 30 = 10 :=
    by rw [Nat.count_mod_eq_zero, Nat.mod_eq_zero_iff_divides, Nat.dvd_def, Nat.zero_lt_three, Nat.lt_div_iff_mul_lt]
  exact h'.symm.trans h
